Gossip tile logic for packet handling, signing, metrics, and contact info updates.

# Purpose
`fd_tile_gossip` defines the gossip tile for Firedancer. It is a tile implementation that joins the topology, allocates scratch memory, and connects the tile to the gossip engine, keyguard client, keyswitch state, and network output links. The file sets up the tile context, loads the node identity key, fills the local contact info, and creates the `fd_gossip` instance with callbacks for packet send, message signing, and ping tracker updates. It also defines the tile entry point `fd_tile_gossip`, which provides the init, seccomp, file descriptor, and run hooks used by the runtime.

The file also handles all input paths for the tile. It maps input links to message kinds such as shred version updates, signed vote traffic, stake updates, and gossip network packets, then dispatches each fragment to the correct handler in [`returnable_frag`](<#returnable_frag>). It advances gossip state during credit processing and housekeeping, updates metrics from the gossip, CRDS, and ping tracker subsystems, and publishes outgoing packets and ping status changes through stem links.
